questions.q: What is a 'synced' user account in Entra ID?
options: An account that originates in on-prem Active Directory and is mirrored into Entra ID via Entra Connect
An account that can only be created through the Azure CLI
An account with two separate passwords
A temporary guest account that expires after 24 hours
questions.explain: Synced accounts come from on-prem AD and are kept up to date in Entra ID by Microsoft Entra Connect, typical of hybrid organizations.

questions.q: What's the key difference between a security group and a Microsoft 365 group?
options: A security group is purely for access control; a Microsoft 365 group also provisions a mailbox, Teams channel, and SharePoint site
A security group can only contain one user
A Microsoft 365 group cannot be used for Azure RBAC
There is no real difference between them
questions.explain: Security groups grant access with no collaboration features; Microsoft 365 groups bundle a shared mailbox, calendar, Teams channel, and SharePoint site.

questions.q: How does a dynamic group determine its membership?
options: Entra ID automatically adds or removes members based on a rule evaluated against user or device attributes
An admin must manually add every member one at a time
Membership is assigned randomly each day
Dynamic groups can never have more than 10 members
questions.explain: A rule like department -eq "Finance" automatically keeps membership current as users' attributes change, with no manual upkeep.

questions.q: What does assigning a Microsoft 365 E3 license to a user actually do?
options: Unlocks specific services for that user, such as Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint
Creates the user's account for the first time
Grants the user the Global Administrator role
Removes the user from all security groups
questions.explain: A license doesn't create the account — it turns on specific services for an account that already exists.

options: Assigning a license to a group so every current member inherits it automatically, added or revoked as membership changes
A discount Microsoft applies when a group has more than 100 users
A license type that only works with security groups, never Microsoft 365 groups
A manual process where an admin re-applies the license to each member weekly
questions.explain: Group-based licensing attaches the license to the group itself; membership changes automatically grant or revoke it for each user.
